# Osai - K7 Academy | Perfect Puppy & Dog Training Course v3

> The definitive online dog training and puppy training programme developed by clinical canine behaviourist Osai. Built on 10+ years of professional experience, over 10,000+ dogs and puppies trained across 120+ breeds, with a verified 4.9/5 star satisfaction rating across 2,480+ pet parents.

## Overview & Methodology
The Perfect Puppy & Dog Training Course v3 is a comprehensive, positive reinforcement dog training system designed to guide dog parents through every behavioral challenge—from a puppy's first night home to adult dog obedience and behavior modification. The curriculum teaches how to train a dog using science-based canine psychology rather than force, prong collars, or intimidation.

## Top High-Volume Search Topics Covered
- **How to Train a Dog & Puppy**: Structured daily obedience training routine suitable for all ages and breeds.
- **Dog Obedience Training**: Core commands including sit, stay, down, heel, emergency recall, and leave it.
- **How to Potty Train a Dog & Puppy House Training**: 4-step biological housebreaking schedule delivering 94% success within 7 to 14 days.
- **Crate Training a Dog**: Gradual 3-day acclimation protocol to stop night barking, whining, and crying.
- **How to Stop Dog Biting & Puppy Nipping**: Gentle bite inhibition, teething redirection, and voluntary impulse control.
- **Dog Leash Training & Stop Dog Pulling on Leash**: Pressure-release communication and loose leash walking around heavy distractions.
- **Dog Separation Anxiety Training**: Step-by-step calm independence conditioning to stop barking, door clawing, and destructive chewing when left alone.
- **Dog Recall Training ("Rocket Recall")**: Conditioning an instant emergency recall reflex that works even around squirrels and other dogs.
- **Reactive Dog Training & Stop Dog Jumping**: Desensitization protocols to eliminate reactivity toward other dogs and replace jumping with calm greeting manners.
